meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 给 Claude 接上一个 Dial 电话号码，可以收发短信、接听 AI 语音来电。技能会从 channels 分支复制 Dial 适配器和配对助手，安装 qrcode、构建并跑注册测试，再把号码注册成消息组。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 加上一个 Dial 电话号码时触发。之后会依次安装 dial CLI、用邮箱验证码登录、确认号码、设置来电问候语并重启服务。

say.text: 帮我加上 Dial 电话号码，我要用短信和 AI 语音接电话
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并重启服务

say.text: 这条线路只允许我配对的手机发消息进来
把拨入这个号码的来电问候语改成：你好，请留言

howto.what_en: Gives the agent a Dial phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. The skill copies the Dial adapter and pairing helper from the channels branch, installs qrcode, builds, runs the registration test, and registers the line as a messaging group.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Dial phone number to Claude. Setup then installs the dial CLI, verifies by email code, confirms the line, sets the inbound greeting, and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number for me; I want SMS and AI voice calls
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, restarts

say_en.text: Only the phone I pair may text this line
Change the inbound call greeting to: Hello, please leave a message
